cell_texture.method: both inputs converted to sRGB; bilinear reference ROI; 4 px edge excluded

limitations: Live order values and items differ from the reference.
Reference cell proportions are user-approved; 54 inventory slots remain as 6x9 rather than deleting a row.
Generated UI-free background is an art-direction match, not an identical pixel plate.
Cell similarity is not a whole-screen aesthetic score.
